cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28...3.30)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(SQLite3 LANGUAGES C)
else()
  enable_language(C)
endif()

# Vendored from https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3530400.zip and
# sqlite-src-3530400.zip (SQLite 3.53.4, public domain). FTS5 is compiled as
# part of the core (SQLITE_CORE); fts5/fts5.c is the single-file amalgamation
# assembled from the split ext/fts5 sources by tools/make_fts5c.ps1 (an exact
# port of upstream tool/mkfts5c.tcl), and fts5parse.{c,h} is generated by
# lemon(1) from ext/fts5/fts5parse.y at vendor time.

add_library(sqlite3 STATIC amalgamation/sqlite3.c fts5/fts5.c)

target_include_directories(sqlite3 PUBLIC
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/amalgamation"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fts5"
)

target_compile_definitions(
  sqlite3
  PRIVATE
    SQLITE_CORE
    SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5
    SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1
    SQLITE_OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION
    SQLITE_DEFAULT_MEMSTATUS=0
    SQLITE_DQS=0
)

# Vendored SQLite carries benign warnings; disable its warnings, not ours.
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(sqlite3 PRIVATE /W0)
else()
  target_compile_options(sqlite3 PRIVATE -w)
endif()

set_target_properties(sqlite3 PROPERTIES FOLDER deps)
